tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: The blood count is largely within normal limits, except for mildly elevated erythrocytes and increased platelet mean volume and distribution width, which may indicate increased platelet turnover or activation. No evidence of anemia, leukocytosis, or thrombocytopenia. Correlation with clinical context is recommended; consider repeating platelet indices if clinically indicated.
